title: A weekly plan becomes visible progress
lines: 01  Plan the week with dates, duration and routine details.
02  Describe your availability and review an AI scheduling proposal.
03  See the completed share of your weekly plan.

title: A small product works end to end
lines:
Weekly planning

AI weekly planner
Describe availability, review a proposal and approve dates.

Private cloud journal
Sign up, sign in and load another device.

title: Simple code connects to managed services
lines:
Browser app
Forms, journal state and proposal review.
Approval uses the existing save flow.

Supabase
Auth and owner-only journal access.
Edge Function validates AI requests.

OpenAI

The API key stays in Supabase Secrets. The server checks ownership, quotas and output.

title: The user approves every AI change
lines: 01  Read availability and existing workout metadata.
02  Ask the model for a structured weekday proposal.
03  Validate ids and dates, then show a preview.
04  Save the approved dates with revision checks.

title: AI proposals have their own validation checks
lines: Two real model calls per AI browser run. Invalid and stale output cases use labelled mocks.
Daily and global limits were checked. Hosted test CI is not configured.

title: A five-minute demo tells the story
lines: Register, mark a current workout complete and reload the journal.
Open next week and add a small set of planned workouts.
Describe available days, request AI help and inspect the proposal.
Approve the schedule, reload and show the saved dates.

title: A focused MVP follows the clarified brief
lines: Production: a public HTTPS app and a public GitHub repository.
Core product: workout planning, completion and weekly progress.
RPG today: visual style. Avatars, XP and levels remain future work.
AI today: a server-backed scheduler. Trained ML and CrewAI remain optional.
Limits: AI suggestions need review. Emails are unverified and recovery is unavailable.
